title: Case latency fit
description: The latency fit a case provides (MiSArch: timing/latency_fit.json): per database statement, per commit and per publish the latency without CPU, on the database server's DELAY resource. core/generator/derive.py class Structure reads the object under `latency` when present, else the top level; without the file it uses placeholders.

estimate.description: A fitted value: a number, or {value, se} (derive Structure: value; se goes into the source label).

oneOf.description: A fitted value with its standard error.

fit.description: The latency fit: latency without CPU per statement, commit and publish. Also carries (not read by the generator): commitUnit, unit, model, regime, source, parts, residualSdMs, alternative, points, residuals, readsCheck, dbLatencyPerAccess, skippedSlowSegments, windows.

stmtRoundTripMs.description: Round trip per database statement, ms (derive Structure.lat, clamped at 0).

publishWaitMs.description: Publisher's wait per publish, ms (derive Structure.lat).

headline.description: The commit proxy: one commit per writing handler or per write statement (derive Structure.lat commitUnit; default perWritingHandler).

n.description: Number of fitted points (derive source label).
